Economics.comment: CAPEX in EUR/(t clinker/h)/year or as a piecewise function, CAPEX_MEA in EUR/(tCO2/h)/year, OPEX_variable in EUR/tonne total output, OPEX_fixed in % of CAPEX_annual. NOTE: this technology's _define_capex_parameters/_define_opex fully override the base Technology class, so top-level fix_capex/opex_variable/opex_fixed below are NOT actually read -- only capex_model, unit_capex, piecewise_capex, discount_rate, lifetime, decommission_cost, and everything under other_economics are used. They are kept here only for schema consistency with other technology files.

other_economics.comment: opex_var_oxy and opex_var_MEA are placeholders (0) -- no source data was available for these; replace with real EUR/tonne CO2 (or relevant unit) variable opex figures before solving with this technology.

Performance.comment: contains fitting data on unit of input, technology types and input/output carriers
